notes: Offsets are [dx, dy] from the body anchor (the Warden's ground position, body pixel (60, 109)) to each part's own anchor. Mirrored parts are flipped horizontally around their anchor (anchor x becomes cell_w - 1 - x). Draw in draw_order (back to front). The fists float: move them freely during attacks (a slam lands where the fist anchor is). Assembled height: about 120 px from the crystal tips to the feet, 114 px to the top of the hood.

hurtboxes.notes: Suggested vulnerable circles, [dx, dy, r] from the body anchor.

bob.notes: Suggested idle breathing: body, head, heart and crystals rise 1 px together every ~1 s; fists bob on their own (baked in).
